visual_action: The video displays a static screenshot of a tweet from an account called "FactPost". The tweet includes a photo of a man in a Border Patrol uniform, identified as Greg Bovino, and text accusing him of inappropriately flirting with a journalist. The tweet also shows a small screenshot of a Twitter exchange. The video then slowly zooms in to show the full Twitter thread between users "Commander Op At Large CA Gregory" and "amanda moore".
